# korean-word-of-the-day — static two-file resting screen, no runtime surface to monitor

> [!warning] **At a glance:** healthy by construction — two static files, no API, no network, no keys; the only failure mode is a malformed word-bank entry, which the test suite guards.

## Behavioral contracts

- **deterministic rotation** — the word of the day is chosen by local calendar date with no API, tokens, or network involved (`words.js:16`); enforced by the date-pin logic in `tests/test_korean_pin.js`.
- **data-only word additions** — the word bank shape mirrors exactly what the Resting Screen design renders, so adding a word is a data change, never a layout change (`words.js:3`); enforced by the shape-completeness assertions in `tests/test_korean_pin.js`.
- **day one matches the approved mockup** — index 0 is 설레다 so the first day renders the approved design exactly (`words.js:17`); enforced by the pin test for that date.
- **no blank panels** — every pin entry is shape-complete so the screen can never render blank panels; enforced by the shape-completeness assertions in `tests/test_korean_pin.js`.
- **hero line never overflows** — the hero line auto-shrinks past 4 syllables (`words.js:19`); enforced by the layout CSS in `index.html`.

## Health

There is no runtime health endpoint, process, or timer. The product is two static files (`index.html`, `words.js`) opened directly in a browser. Aliveness is the file serving correctly; there is no `/health` JSON, no port, no service.

A FAILURE is a malformed word-bank entry that renders a blank panel or a broken layout. A QUIET state — no one viewing the screen — is normal and is not a failure. The grocery-SLA lesson does not apply: there is no background activity to conflate with breakage.

The only observable health signal is the test suite passing (see Tests). A passing suite means the word bank is shape-complete and the date-pin logic is correct.

## Policies & SLAs

| name | value | source config |
|---|---|---|
| word-bank entry count | 18 | `words.js` |
| hero-line shrink threshold | 4 syllables | `words.js:19` |
| day-one word | 설레다 | `words.js:17` |

No SLA windows, retry counts, or freshness thresholds exist — there is no network, no API, and no scheduled job.

## Tests

Run with:

```
node tests/test_korean_pin.js
```

The suite covers the date-pin logic: a pinned date renders its pinned word, pins never shift the surrounding rotation, and every pin entry is shape-complete so the screen can never render blank panels.

The suite does NOT cover visual layout rendering, browser behavior, or the word clock view. UNKNOWN (fact not harvested) — the exact test count is not recorded in the fact sheet.

## Deploy & operate

Ship path: commit to the repository at `https://github.com/cptntrps/korean-word-of-the-day.git`; the change is live when the static files are served. There is no build step, no gate, no restart — opening `index.html` in any browser is the whole deployment.

Restart command: none — there is no process to restart.

Rollback: revert the commit; the previous file state is restored on the next serve. No rollback mechanism beyond source control exists.

## Secrets handling

No secrets exist. The fact sheet records zero env keys, zero port tokens, and zero network calls. There is nothing to rotate, and no credential reaches any process. Operator response to a secret concern: verify the repository contains no credential material; none is expected by design.
